basic_details.job_title: IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow (Mechanical Engineering) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Mechanical Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology Indore, has invited applications for a Junior Research Fellow (JRF) in the funded research project "BP-Sense: A Compact, Automated Blood Pressure Measurement for Remote Health Monitoring". The stipend is Rs. 37,000 per month + HRA (as per funding agency rules), for one year, extendible till completion of the project. The essential qualification is Masters in Engineering with research, design and development experience. Applications go through the online form or by email to [email protected], and must be sent latest by 27

how_to_apply: Submit your information along with a detailed CV through the "Submit Form Here" link in the notice (the Application Form link in the table below).
Alternatively, send an email to [email protected] with the subject line "Application for SRF position in a Project".
Send the application latest by 27 November 2026.
Documents named in the notice: a detailed CV; documents in support of educational qualifications and experience certificates, which must be produced at the time of the selection process.
important_instructions: Only shortlisted candidates are informed by email about the interview. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview. Educational qualification and experience documents must be produced at the time of the selection process. HRA is payable as per funding agency rules.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential qualification is Masters in Engineering with research, design and development experience. The notice describes the desirable criterion as follows: candidates having exposure to development in device/product development are encouraged to apply. The notice prints no age limit. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The stipend is Rs. 37,000 per month + HRA, as per funding agency rules. The duration is one year, extendible till completion of the project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Submit your information along with a detailed CV through the "Submit Form Here" link in the notice (the Application Form link in the table below). Alternatively, send an email to [email protected] with the subject line "Application for SRF position in a Project". Send the application latest by 27 November 2026. Documents named in the notice: a detailed CV; documents in support of educational qualifications and experience certificates, which must be produced at the time of the selection process.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be informed by email to attend the interview. The notice does not give the interview date or venue. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing for the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates are informed by email about the interview. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview. Educational qualification and experience documents must be produced at the time of the selection process. HRA is payable as per funding agency rules.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Indore JRF post?
faq.answer: The last date is 27 November 2026. The notice asks for applications "latest by" that date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification for the IIT Indore JRF post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is Masters in Engineering with research, design and development experience. Exposure to device/product development is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the stipend for the IIT Indore JRF?
faq.answer: The stipend is Rs. 37,000 per month + HRA, as per funding agency rules.

faq.question: Q4. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs. 37,000 stipend?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice states the stipend as Rs. 37,000 per month + HRA (as per funding agency rules).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the IIT Indore JRF post?
faq.answer: Submit your information and a detailed CV through the form link in the notice, or email [email protected]. Both routes must be used by 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What subject line should the application email carry?
faq.answer: The notice asks for the subject line "Application for SRF position in a Project".

faq.question: Q7. How long is the IIT Indore JRF engagement?
faq.answer: The duration is one year, extendible till completion of the project.

faq.question: Q8. Is TA/DA paid for attending the interview?
